in_marathi.name: Rakshith
in_marathi.long_meaning: Rakshith हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Rakshith is a name derived from the Sanskrit word 'Rakshas', meaning a protector or guardian. It is also associated with the Hindu god Rama, who is known for his protective and warrior qualities. In Telugu and Kannada, the name Rakshith is also used as a synonym for Rakesh.
